value.title: one-message-one-delivery
value.summary: A message is delivered exactly once: the extension that consumes a pushed event can ack its queue row, so the daemon never also pointers (or, post-s122, re-types) the same body.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Diagnosed defect (assets/inputs/omp-extension-delivery-findings.md, file:line receipts): DeliveryService publishes message.pushed even when the computed outcome is Queued (crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:298-322); PushedEvent carries NO job_id (:527-539) while ack requires the claimed job_id (:30-38, :340-413). The pi/omp extension therefore injects the full body (rust-runtime.ts:104-123 → session.ts:589-600) but cannot ack, the row stays live, and the pointer worker announces it (pointer/worker.rs:292-327) because uds can_deliver rejects non-Claude harnesses. Observed live: omp got the body at transcripts/accept-omp-lark-%2167.txt:145 and the pointer at :153. URGENCY: after s122 the unacked row will TYPE the body a second time — the duplicate gets worse.

sections.name: goals
value: One message = one delivery for a pi/omp seat: body injected once, no pointer, no retype
The consumer can ack what it took — job_id (or an equivalent claim handle) reaches the extension with the pushed event
The daemon never announces/types a row an extension consumer has legitimately taken

Wire change is additive and skew-safe: an OLD extension against a NEW daemon must not lose delivery, and a NEW extension against an OLD daemon must not double-ack (state which direction fails loudly and prove it)

sections.name: non_goals
value: Event-stream cursor + reconnect/replay (the SECOND defect in the same findings doc — its own unit, own witness)
Claude socket path and s121 consent stamping
Widening uds can_deliver to non-Claude harnesses (that is the pi-extension transport question, not this seam)

value.text: Live witness: an omp seat receives ONE message and shows exactly one rendering — the injected [pij from <id>] body — and NO [pij-rs …]message waiting pointer; proven in the pane AND by the queue row reaching a terminal acked state
Pre-fix red: the same scenario on the unfixed tree produces both renderings (reproduce the observed duplicate before fixing it)
A body the extension did NOT consume (no live consumer attached) still reaches the seat by the daemon's own rung — the fix must not create a silent drop; both worlds emit a positive artifact
Version skew tested in both directions with a stated, loud failure mode (old extension/new daemon; new extension/old daemon) — no silent body loss, no double-ack

Compatible with s122: with tmux full-body typing enabled, an extension-consumed message is typed ZERO additional times (run the composed check against s122's branch or state precisely why it cannot be run yet)
pij-gate green, typecheck green, vitest green modulo the known pre-existing npm-resolution failure

value.title: Phase 1 — ack seam + duplicate witness
value.brief: One unit; PM codes it, reviewer after. Spans Rust daemon and the TS extension — one seam, two sides.
